title: win-port-suite variables
description: Configuration variables for win-port-suite empirical benchmark orchestrator.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_VERSION.description: Specific version of win-port-suite to install ('1.0.0' or 'latest').

WIN_PORT_SUITE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading win-port-suite artifacts.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying win-port-suite releases.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated win_port empirical sub-suites to run (E0 through E7).

WIN_PORT_SUITE_RESULTS_DIR.description: Directory where raw win_port JSON/CSV artifacts (raw/*.json) and generated_metrics.tex are written.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_ECOSYSTEM_DIR.description: Parent directory containing the 14 win_port repositories and freebsd-src.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_PAPER_DIR.description: Path to ../new_research/win_port containing win_port_paper.tex and win_port_appendix.tex.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_SYNTHETIC.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling offline deterministic synthetic fixtures for CI self-testing.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling dry-run execution of external VM/host commands.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_ALLOW_DIRTY.description: Flag (0 or 1) permitting dirty git worktrees during local iterative development.

WIN_PORT_SUITE_BUILD_PDF.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling pdflatex + bibtex compilation of win_port_paper.pdf and win_port_appendix.pdf in E7.
